messages:
marta: Heads-up — CI flakes on the new eval-runner smoke for the embeddings+rerank suite after the quantized model bring-up. failing test is the integration smoke that checks metric contracts.
vikram: ugh, what is the failure log look like?
marta: snippet from the job: `ERROR: metric registry mismatch: got [ndcg@k=10,mrr@k=10], expected [ndcg@10,mrr@10]` — runner asserts metric names exactly.
ryan: oh right, we changed the metric naming when adding flexible-k support. runner still uses the old canonical names.
audrey: can we map both forms in the short term? a small shim so CI passes while we decide on canonical naming? :+1:
marta: here's a minimal repro you can run locally: `./tools/eval_runner --suite rerank --model path/to/q8_model --metrics-config tests/ci/metric-config.json`
marta: failing output (from CI):
```
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z eval-runner INFO loading metrics from tests/ci/metric-config.json
2026-03-10T15:12:03Z eval-runner ERROR metric registry mismatch: expected 'ndcg@10' but got 'ndcg@k=10'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runner/main.py", line 212, in main
    raise MetricContractError(msg)
MetricContractError: metric name mismatch
```
vikram: can we add a simple normalizer that converts `ndcg@k=10` -> `ndcg@10` and similarly for `mrr`? that should be safe for now.
ryan: I'll open a tiny PR in the runner to accept both forms and add unit tests. also will add a CI smoke step that runs the metric name normalizer on the config bundle.
audrey: long-term we should add schema validation for metric defs (type, k, aggregator) and a docs note for model-onboarding so model teams know the canonical format. create an RFC?
marta: yes RFC would help. for immediate unblock, can we also make the CI failure message more actionable — include the offending config and a suggested mapping? right now it just says mismatch.
ryan: good call. i'll make the error include `offender: ndcg@k=10 -> suggested: ndcg@10` and add a one-liner fixer `tools/metric_normalizer.py --apply`.
ci-bot: CI failed for commit e3a7f2 on branch feature/quantize-onboard — eval-runner/integration-smoke exited 1. See logs: ci.redwood.internal/job/1245
vikram: adding dashboard alert so we notice regressions earlier: tag the rerank suite with `eval-smoke` and create a redwood-console alert when flakey > 3 in 24h.
audrey: also pls add a small golden-query set that runs pre-merge. 10 queries per suite, quick embeddings/dot-product sanity. keeps runtime cheap.
marta: I'll add the golden queries + update the onboarding checklist to run them before adding a new quantized model.
ryan: PR is up: ryan/accept-metric-variants. includes normalizer + unit tests + CI smoke change. request review from @marta @vikram.
marta: reviewing now. thanks all.
eval-bot: NOTE: eval-harness version bumped to 0.9.3 in the PR; ensure downstream dashboards read the new schema.
vikram: once merged, i'll kick CI and re-run the failing jobs to validate the fix.
marta: re-run passed locally for me with normalizer applied. will merge after one more review. :shipit:
ryan: thanks — follow-up tasks: RFC for metric schema (audrey), dashboard alert (vikram), onboarding checklist update (marta).
